'''V'saine''' was a city that existed during the [[Age of Legends]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, V'saine}} It was best known as the home of [[Collam Daan]], a great university of silver and blue domes whose architecture was overshadowed only by the [[Sharom]] that floated overhead.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 3}} Like all other cities of the Age of Legends, it was utterly ruined and only legends of it have survived.

The only known descriptions of the city of V'saine are given by those who visit the [[Glass columns|Glass Columns]] of [[Rhuidean]] and the [[Visions of Rhuidean|Visions]] shown within and of those, only Rand al'Thor's vision has been spoken aloud.
